description:
IAM-style policy-based authorization for the Weavric. A block declares a demand
        (action + resource ARN); grants are Allow/Deny policy statements supplied by the host. The grant
        evaluator is built from the engine's own variable/condition/result blocks, run in a read-only sandbox.
        Block-level interceptors enforce the demand at the moment each trigger, variable, condition, action,
        or result runs.
